query: The Oldest Drawer Restocking, you open the oldest drawer at the bottom of Pell's wall. Inside is one yellowed card: a draught "of your own strength", in a hand older than Pell's. Pell sees it and counts to three under his breath. "That one costs the brewer," he says. "Measure twice." Copy the recipe You copy it out carefully. Pell watches you do it and says nothing, then corrects one of your measures in your copy. That is the closest he comes to permission. Close the drawer You close it. Pell nods once and goes back to his scales. Later you notice he has relabelled the drawer, clearly, "Not yet."
